items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Retained worker/reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: maintain private launch gates, continue bounded read-only security evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence work only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release provenance, dependencies, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
